authorization: 2026-10-17 owner: local restore-only matched acceptance comparison; no cloud/external/fit/rebuild
confirmation: oral-GSA remains frozen/unacquired; separate source/genome/replicon/taxonomy/overlap/truth and cost admission before execution

criteria.abandon: abandon this gate as a universal quality selector if it cannot protect useful parents across contexts; never infer markers/CPM are useless
criteria.keep: engineering/full-DNA contracts pass; directional full-reference recovery and target losses vs parent/old children reported in both contexts; protective result can be retained as safety guard
criteria.modify: graph-positive selections still cause target loss, or useful RB splits are vetoed; revise acceptance model in a future prospectively specified test, not this run
criteria.no_universal_effect_threshold: effect sizes are development decision aids; no post-hoc rule/threshold change

design.CPM: working development grouping direction; original E011 threshold failure retained; no resolution grid or stronger-binner claim
design.RB: historical matched diagnostic context, not recommendation to return to RB
design.independence: graph support differs from marker conflict removal, but graph shares encoder/weights with grouping; not biological independence
design.markers: retain product priority; trusted calls propose splits, duplication alone is not proof of contamination; no truth-based family blacklist
design.null: all CPM proposals may be vetoed because CPM already optimized this objective; equal-to-parent result demonstrates protection only

evaluation.denominators: all 145702 contigs /231678157bp, 156 primary targets /554661890 full provided bp, all origin/length/eligibility/clean-marker populations
metrics: weighted/macro full-reference R95 at 200kb bin/95% full-DNA purity
unchanged raw/learned geometry from accepted E010/E011, no new vectors
evaluation.truth: admitted conservative E009 v2, separate process after selection

marker_audit.limits: family membership is not universal single-copy specificity or functional validation; no reference sequence reannotation; whole-chain identity does not establish gene-specific identity
marker_audit.method: clip every retained qualifying competing PAF CIGAR piece and global nn veto to cached gene/domain coordinates, exact canonical circular normalization; no new aligner
marker_audit.scope: all cached adopted seed families in both contexts; report the four previously observed harmed CPM parents separately

question: Can independent retained graph support veto destructive marker proposals while retaining useful ones?

rule.alternatives: original full parent or exact retained children/noise only; non-adopted proposals leave parent
rule.density_source: unchanged E011 median positive graph edge weight / 30
rule.name: retained-child positive CPM gain
rule.noise: each retained unassigned vertex is a distinct singleton for scoring only; every lost edge counts; actual noise stays unassigned
rule.selection_inputs: features/unit geometry/fixed sparse graph, pre/post partitions and existing clean marker calls; no truth/taxonomy/K
rule.tie: keep original parent; math.fsum edge weights, no practical threshold fit
